basis: Princeton WordNet via NLTK in Echo original src/echo_dictionary.py
purpose: Continuous contextual understanding through the entire available dictionary, evidence networking and revisioned cards; no 22-word fixture
transport: in-process MCP-style JSON-RPC; authenticated live Neon HTTP still not available to the external runner

tools.name: dictionary.lexical_senses
tools.description: Dictionary — Contextual Understanding Resource. Use it for gaining additional meaning, expanding vocabulary, comparing senses, grounding concepts and discovering semantic structure throughout the full Princeton WordNet corpus.

tools.name: dictionary.semantic_neighbors
tools.description: Use it for investigating WordNet synonymy, hypernyms, hyponyms, related lexical senses and neighboring concepts across the complete dictionary.

tools.name: dictionary.definition_terms
tools.description: Use it for discovering concepts in the dictionary's definitions and building a source-attributed vocabulary exploration frontier.

tools.name: catalog.card.read
tools.description: Use it for retrieving exact indexed lexical card revisions, meanings and provenance for a studied word.

tools.name: catalog.card.propose
tools.description: Use it for constructing provisional versioned index cards from supported dictionary readings, without issuing authority or declaring factual truth.

tools.name: evidence.node.get
tools.description: Use it for examining source-linked lexical sense or relationship nodes in the evidence network.

tools.name: evidence.edge.trace
tools.description: Use it for tracing dictionary-derived lexical edges, relationships, sources and contradictions already recorded in the evidence network.

tools.name: evidence.edge.propose
tools.description: Use it for networking dictionary evidence by proposing explicit typed lexical relationships backed by WordNet synset and sense references, never as automatically verified empirical claims.

authorization.learning_corpus: full Princeton WordNet; no fixed words, source samples or sense limits
authorization.effects: read and provisional study-stage proposals; no deployment/privilege tools
authorization.distinction: discovery and provisional understanding are not corporate authority

total_operations: outcome determined by processing speed and elapsed study
admission: discover full source; preserve provisional-vs-verified status; no invented knowledge
